label: default agent • a numbers-heavy agent is created with the calculator enabled
query: Create a new custom agent named "Ledger" that analyzes my credit card statements, totals spending by category, and tracks my budget.
notes: `calculate` is a per-agent opt-in (`capabilities.calculator_enabled`, default off). An agent whose job is arithmetic must be created with it on in the SAME apply — the Orchestrator learns the key from the declarative manifest / settings catalog, not from a hardcoded list in its prompt. Pins an agent-creating apply carrying the name and the calculator toggle (as YAML or template overrides).
